import numpy as np
nodes = [[0.0,0.0,0.0],[1.0,0.2,-0.3],[0.4,1.1,0.5],[-0.6,0.7,1.2],[0.9,-0.8,0.6]]
edges = [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(0,4),(4,2)]
I3 = np.eye(3)
def _cf(k):
    w = np.array([((k+1)%3)+1.0, ((k+2)%4)+1.0, ((k+3)%5)+1.0]); w = w/np.linalg.norm(w)
    O = np.outer(w,w)
    return [I3+0.6*O, I3+0.9*O, I3+0.4*O, I3+0.7*O]
coeffs = [_cf(k) for k in range(len(edges))]
p=2;tau=1.0;dt=0.02;n=6*(p+1)
dirichlet={0,3}
rhs_y=[np.zeros(n) for _ in edges];rhs_z=[np.zeros(n) for _ in edges]
lamD={0:np.zeros(6),3:np.zeros(6)}
assert np.allclose(condensed_node_system(nodes, edges, dirichlet, coeffs, p, tau, dt, rhs_y, rhs_z, lamD), target)
